onboarding_connect.title: Connect your server?
onboarding_connect.subtitle: Use Crit Alarm Cloud, or point the app at your own server.
onboarding_connect.url_helper: The address your server is reachable at.
onboarding_connect.qr_notice: QR scanning is not in this version. Paste the token instead.
onboarding_connect.cloud_description: We run the server. Nothing to set up.
onboarding_connect.self_host_toggle: Run your own server? Connect to it
onboarding_connect.version_incompatible: Your server is {version}. Update it to 0.x, then connect again.
onboarding_connect.hook_subtitle: See Crit Alarm ring while your phone is on silent.
onboarding_connect.hook_step1: 1. Put your phone on silent, or turn on Do Not Disturb.
onboarding_connect.hook_countdown: Ringing in {seconds}s • Lock your screen now
onboarding_connect.celebration_subtitle: Your phone rang and kept ringing until you stopped it. Real pages work the same way.
onboarding_connect.skip_to_dashboard: Not now, take me to my topics
onboarding_connect.celebration_topics_hint: A topic is one thing you want paged about, like your database or your build.
onboarding_connect.admin_token_helper: Your server prints this when it starts. It begins with ad_.
onboarding_connect.offline_notice: No internet right now. You can carry on, and Crit Alarm will connect when you are back online.
onboarding_connect.network_unreachable: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
onboarding_connect.connect_timeout: The server did not answer. Check the address and try again.
onboarding_connect.demo_alarm_body: A test page from Crit Alarm. Stop the alarm to finish setup.
onboarding_connect.hook_no_alarm_body: This phone cannot ring a local test alarm. Real pages still arrive as notifications.

onboarding_permissions.denied_description: Without these, a page cannot reach you or wake your screen.
onboarding_permissions.step1_subtitle: Alert details need notification permission to reach your device.
onboarding_permissions.step2_subtitle: Alarm access lets a page ring through your silent switch and Do Not Disturb until you stop it.
onboarding_permissions.preview_notif_title: “Crit Alarm” Would Like to Send You Notifications
onboarding_permissions.preview_notif_desc: Notifications may include alerts, sounds, and icon badges.
onboarding_permissions.preview_crit_title: Allow “Crit Alarm” to schedule alarms and timers?
onboarding_permissions.preview_crit_desc: This will allow the app to schedule alarms and timers that can play sounds and appear on screen even if a Focus is active.
onboarding_permissions.preview_notif_title_android: Allow Crit Alarm to send you notifications?
onboarding_permissions.preview_notif_desc_android: Pages, warnings and test alarms show up as notifications.
onboarding_permissions.preview_crit_title_android: Allow Crit Alarm to use full-screen alerts?
onboarding_permissions.preview_crit_desc_android: Crit Alarm can take over the screen when a page comes in, even when the phone is locked.
onboarding_permissions.step2_unsupported_title: Your phone can still page you
onboarding_permissions.step2_unsupported_subtitle: Alarms that ring through silent mode need iOS 26. On this phone a page arrives as a notification with sound.

showcase.topic_desc: Critical topics ring through silent mode until you acknowledge them.
showcase.webhook_desc: Copy this endpoint or curl command into your monitoring scripts.
showcase.create_desc: Create separate topics for databases, staging, or quiet alerts.
showcase.settings_desc: Pick custom alarm sounds, repeat intervals, and test alerts anytime.

home.title: Crit Alarm
home.stage_sub_no_topics: Create one, then point a script, cron job or monitor at its endpoint.
home.detail_empty_body: Pick a topic to see its details.

history.title: History
history.summary_empty: No alarms in the last 30 days.
history.empty_body: Alarms you acknowledge show up here with how long they rang.
history.meta_resolved: Rang {duration}. Resolved when the check passed.
history.detail_empty_body: Pick an incident to see its details.

topic_detail.critical_toggle_subtitle: Rings through silent mode and Do Not Disturb
topic_detail.critical_needs_alarm: Turn on Alarms in Settings first. Without it a critical alert arrives as a quiet notification.
topic_detail.ack_failed: The server did not confirm. This phone is quiet, but the page is still open. Tap Stop the alarm again.
topic_detail.stage_sub_empty: No messages yet. Anything sent here rings at {priority} priority.
topic_detail.delete_dialog_content: This removes the topic, its tokens and every alarm it has ever raised. Anything still sending to it stops working.

topic_tokens.load_failed: Could not read this topic's tokens.
topic_tokens.revoke_dialog_content: Anything still sending with this token stops working right away. The topic keeps its other tokens.

topic_messages.empty_body: Anything sent to this topic shows up here.

create_topic.title: New topic
create_topic.critical_toggle_subtitle: Rings through silent mode and Do Not Disturb
create_topic.token_warning: The token is shown once. Save it now.
create_topic.name_error_invalid: Use 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Try prod-db.

critical_alarm.fallback_body: This page arrived with no message.
critical_alarm.no_alarm_body: There is no open page on this device right now.

critical_alarm.silence_button: Stop the noise on this phone
critical_alarm.ack_failed: The server did not confirm. This phone is quiet, but the page is still open. Tap Stop the alarm again.

lock_screen.ringing_pill: Ringing through silent mode. Tap to acknowledge.

settings.title: Settings
settings.stage_sub: Quiet hours on. Critical still rings.
settings.disconnect_dialog_content: You will stop receiving pages until you connect again.
settings.server_disconnected_description: Connect a server to start receiving pages.
settings.analytics_subtitle: Which screens you open. No topic names, no message content.
settings.crash_reports_subtitle: What the app was doing when it crashed, plus your device model.

settings.health_row_subtitle_ok: Everything needed to ring is on

device_permissions.title: Health
device_permissions.stage_sub_all_granted: All set. Ready to wake you at 3am.
device_permissions.stage_sub_required: Some pages will not reach you until these are on.
device_permissions.item_notifications_description: Off means no page reaches you.
device_permissions.item_full_screen_intent_description: Off means a critical page will not wake the screen.
device_permissions.item_battery_optimization_description: Off means pages can arrive late.
device_permissions.item_time_sensitive_description: Off means iOS holds a page for your next summary instead of showing it now.
device_permissions.item_alarms_description: Off means a page cannot ring through silent mode or Do Not Disturb.
device_permissions.stage_sub_full_screen_off: Full screen alarms are disabled. Alarms will vibrate only.

paywall.self_hosted_note: Self-hosting? Every critical alert is free.
paywall.feedback_no_active_restored: Nothing to restore on this account.

search.title: Search

search.no_matches_body: Try a topic name, a date like Sep 14, or a setting such as sound.

account.row_subtitle: Sign in to keep your alarms when you change phone
account.signed_out_pitch: Sign in to get your alarms back on a new phone, and to use more than one device.
account.sign_out_failed: Could not sign out. You are still signed in on this phone. Try again.
account.error_sign_in_failed: Sign-in did not go through. Try again.
account.error_other_identity: This phone already belongs to another account. Sign out of that one first, then sign in again.
account.choose_title: You already have alarms on this phone
account.choose_body: This phone holds {topics} and {incidents}. Choose what happens to them.
account.keep_both_body: The topics on this phone join the account you are signing in to. Your webhooks keep working. Alert history from both sides can be read from either one.
account.start_fresh_body: You sign in to the other account and leave what is on this phone behind.

start_fresh_tokens.one: The webhook token for the 1 topic on this phone stops working. Whatever publishes to it goes quiet.
start_fresh_tokens.other: The webhook tokens for the {} topics on this phone stop working. Whatever publishes to them goes quiet.
